parameters.query:
WITH ctx AS (
  SELECT * FROM public.get_user_context_and_catalog($1::text, $2::text, $3::text, $4::text)
),
hist AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(h.message ORDER BY h.id ASC),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ) AS recent_history
  FROM (
    SELECT id, message
    FROM public.n8n_chat_histories
    WHERE session_id = ($1::text || ':' || $2::text)
    ORDER BY id DESC
    LIMIT 6
  ) h
)
SELECT
  ctx.*,
  hist.recent_history
FROM ctx
CROSS JOIN hist;

nodes.name: Roteador: Comandos Rápidos vs AI Agent

parameters.query:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN $2::text = 'list_only' THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'success', true,
      'action_applied', 'list_only',
      'subscribed_sector_slugs', COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(us.sector_slug ORDER BY us.sector_slug) FROM public.user_subscriptions us WHERE us.user_id = $1::uuid), ARRAY[]::text[]),
      'subscribed_sector_names', COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(s.name ORDER BY s.slug) FROM public.user_subscriptions us JOIN public.sectors s ON s.slug = us.sector_slug WHERE us.user_id = $1::uuid), ARRAY[]::text[])
    )
    ELSE public.manage_user_subscription($1::uuid, $2::text, $3::text[], NULL)
  END AS subscription_result;

WITH user_sectors AS (
  SELECT
    s.slug,
    s.name,
    m.regime_type,
    m.estimated_effective_rate,
    m.reduction_percent,
    m.legal_basis,
    m.credit_rules,
    m.transition_schedule
  FROM public.sectors s
  JOIN public.tax_reform_matrix m ON m.sector_slug = s.slug
  WHERE s.slug IN (
    SELECT us.sector_slug FROM public.user_subscriptions us WHERE us.user_id = $1::uuid
  )
  ORDER BY s.slug
),
recent_ordinances AS (
  SELECT
    o.act_number,
    o.title,
    o.official_url,
    o.published_at,
    o.escopo,
    o.grau_urgencia,
    o.resumo_geral,
    o.previsao_vigencia
  FROM public.ordinances o
  WHERE o.escopo = 'GERAL'
     OR o.affected_sector_slugs && COALESCE(
       ARRAY(SELECT us.sector_slug FROM public.user_subscriptions us WHERE us.user_id = $1::uuid),
       ARRAY[]::text[]
     )
  ORDER BY o.published_at DESC, o.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 4
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(row_to_json(u)) FROM user_sectors u), '[]'::jsonb) AS matrix_rows,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(row_to_json(r)) FROM recent_ordinances r), '[]'::jsonb) AS ordinances_rows;

RETURNING id;
